verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Maritime builds agents from GitHub repos and streams build logs. Nothing documents Maritime itself versioning automations (agents or triggers), offering a review step for changes, or rolling back to a prior deployment. Git history is a user-side workaround, and append-only session logs for one framework concern run replay, not automation versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
